event_text: GitHub opens a status incident: degraded performance for Actions and Webhooks
Git Operations, Pull Requests, Actions, Issues, Packages and Pages are listed with degraded availability
GitHub says the failures are due to high database load and it is working to reduce the load
GitHub says it has updated its database load distribution and is starting to see recovery
GitHub marks the incident resolved and promises a detailed root cause analysis
Git LFS operations are degraded; GitHub later blames a large volume of automated, unauthenticated traffic in one region
notes: 21:30 to 00:28 UTC. GitHub opened this incident at 6:06 PM ET and resolved it at 7:43 PM ET.
